sources.title: World Population Prospects 2024, demographic indicators (medium variant)
sources.provider: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division
sources.license: CC BY 3.0 IGO (UN WPP terms of use)
sources.citation: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division (2024). World Population Prospects 2024.
sources.notes: Population columns are published in thousands; multiplied by 1,000 here. The file has no age-by-sex detail. WPP note codes kept per country as wpp_note_code (ESP 25, USA 32); their text is in the WPP notes table, not fetched.

sources.title: World Development Indicators: SP.DYN.TFRT.IN, SP.POP.TOTL
sources.notes: Cross-check only. WDI fertility and population for many countries draw on UN WPP and national statistics, so agreement is not independent confirmation.

sources.title: Eurostat divorce indicators (demo_ndivind) and marriage indicators (demo_nind)
sources.citation: Eurostat, demo_ndivind and demo_nind, doi:10.2908/DEMO_NDIVIND, doi:10.2908/DEMO_NIND.
sources.notes: EU/EFTA reporting countries only. Status codes (p provisional, e estimated, b break in series, i imputed) kept per value. Divorces in the year per 1,000 average population (all ages). Not the probability that a marriage ends in divorce; depends on how many people are married, on law and on registration.

metrics.label: Total fertility rate, 2023 (estimate)
metrics.universe: Women of reproductive age, whole country
metrics.definition: Average number of live births a woman would have over her reproductive life at the period's age-specific rates.
metrics.caveats: Childbearing behaviour in the period, not ideal or intended family size.

metrics.label: Total fertility rate, 2030 (UN projection)
metrics.universe: Women of reproductive age, whole country
metrics.caveats: Childbearing behaviour in the period, not ideal or intended family size. A model projection, not an observation.

metrics.label: Mean age at childbearing, 2023
metrics.definition: Mean age of mothers at the birth of their children (all birth orders).

metrics.label: Female population, 1 July 2023
metrics.caveats: All ages, not the 20-29 target band.

metrics.label: Women 20-29, 2023
metrics.caveats: Not ingested: needs the WPP population-by-age file.

metrics.label: Crude marriage rate
metrics.definition: Marriages in the year per 1,000 average population.
metrics.caveats: Year differs by country; all-age denominator.

metrics.label: Mean age at first marriage, women
metrics.short: Women's mean age at first marriage
metrics.universe: Women marrying for the first time in the year
metrics.definition: Mean age of women at first marriage in the year.

metrics.label: Crude divorce rate
metrics.definition: Divorces in the year per 1,000 average population.
metrics.caveats: Divorces in the year per 1,000 average population (all ages). Not the probability that a marriage ends in divorce; depends on how many people are married, on law and on registration.

metrics.label: Total fertility rate, World Bank, 2023 (cross-check)
metrics.caveats: Cross-check only; often derived from WPP or national statistics.
